# Sample JSON (all generated by the real engine; every value is synthetic)

| File | Direction | What |
|---|---|---|
| `raw_telemetry_reading.json` | **input** -> `POST /api/v1/live/ingest` | one raw reading (ground-truth columns removed) |
| `live_tick.json` | output of `/live/ingest`, item of `/live/ticks` | the reading + its per-reading analysis (`tick_seq`, `run`, `intelligence`, `emitted_events`) |
| `live_ticks_response_shortened.json` | output `GET /live/ticks` | page wrapper: `engine_instance_id`, `instance_changed`, `run`, `last_tick_seq`, **`next_since_seq`**, `has_more`, `gap_detected` (vitals shortened to "...") |
| `event_HEALTH_REVIEW_REQUIRED.json` / `event_HEALTH_EVENT_ESCALATED.json` / `event_HEALTH_EVENT_RESOLVED.json` | event messages | one example of each message type |
| `health_event_feed_full_ASTRO_01.json` | output `GET /events/feed` | a full incident history of one astronaut (6 messages, 2 incidents) |
| `health_event_feed_paged_limit2.json` | output `GET /events/feed?limit=2` | page cut by `limit`: `has_more=true`, `next_since_seq=2` (the cursor), `last_sequence=6` (do not use) |
| `health_event_feed_6_astronauts.json` | output `GET /events/feed` | feed with several astronauts |
| `live_health_report.json` | output `GET /report` | live report right after an incident |
| `astronauts_summary.json`, `astronauts_summary_6.json` | output `GET /astronauts` | status wall (1 and 6 astronauts) |
| `../sample_analysis.json` | output of the batch pipeline | full report of one astronaut |
